Reviewer: MacBook-Pro.local pool job review-4185 (team-skull), claude-opus-5-5, mkinney; did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers. This is a SAFETY-tier review: the PR changes posted G-code of `assets/posts/haas.cps`.

## Where it ran

Locally, on macOS. The PR head `326770b51` was trial-merged with `upstream/main` `e6849c5ae` (merge `3ebbe0921`). The merge is clean. I did not use the runner.

## What looks good

- Each new word cites a page of the Haas Mill NGC Operator's Manual (2025). The decision record `docs/decisions/1977-haas-ngc-words.md` gives what was chosen and what was left.
- `retractHome()` now writes `G90` after each `G91 G28` retract. The two old `G90` lines in `afterOp()` are removed, so no path writes `G90` twice and no path leaves `G91` active at `M30`.
- `G53 G49 G0 Z..` does not leave the tool length offset off under a cut. Each operation writes a `TOOL` record (`crates/post/src/post/mod.rs:375`), so each section writes `T.. M6` and `G43 H..` again after its safe-start `G49`. The safe-start block already wrote `G49` on main, so the change adds no new state.
- The reverse spindle uses the same pattern as `fanuc.cps` and `mazak.cps`: `spinRev` resets at `OperationName`, and `ask_reverse_spindle` puts `PARAM MillSpindle` before `SECTION`.
- A `G84` under `M4` is refused by name, and no `G84` block is written.
- `coolantOff()` gives `M9` for each code that it does not know. Flood and shower are not changed.
- `tool_gate.rs`: Haas is removed from `M3_ONLY_POSTS`, as decision 4031 says. The tests move the M3-only side to Tormach PathPilot, so the refusal path keeps its coverage.

## Goldens moved (checked line by line)

33 files, +66 / -34. I counted each changed line over all of them:

- 34 safe-start lines: `G17 G90 G5x G40 G49 G80` becomes `G17 G90 G94 G5x G40 G49 G80` (32 with G54, 1 with G55 in `synth_haas.nc`, 1 explain line).
- 32 new `G90` lines (31 plain, 1 explained). Each one is directly after `G28 X0 Y0` and directly before `M30`.
- The explain golden: "WORK OFFSET 1" is removed from the safe-start comment for the 60-character budget, as the body says.
- No other line changed. This agrees with the "Goldens moved" section of the body.

## Results (locally, on the trial merge)

- `cargo test -p camcraft-post` (all targets): 143 binaries, 1331 passed, 0 failed. This includes `setup_change` (31), `haas_dwell_cycles` (6), `inverted_probe` (9, the `macro_b` reader with `G94`), `script_haas`, `explain*`, `recorded_streams`, `fine_bore_cycle`, `bore_cycle`, `ream_cycle`.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib`: 318 passed, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-app` suites, 34 binaries, all green, 0 failed: `conformance` 7, `program_entry` 9, `inverted_axis_display` 5, `coolant_followups` 8, `cutter_hand` 7, `thread_passes` 5, `example_catalog` 43 (4 ignored), `example_catalog_adaptive` 1, `example_catalog_edge_work` 1, `after_op` 10, `between_setups` 10, `control_comp` 9, `coolant` 7, `coolant_air` 4, `fine_bore_cycle` 9, `haas_machines` 3, `post_cycle_feed_spindle` 8, `post_spindle_rule_all` 5, `post_unit_word` 5, `probe_no_coolant` 5, `program_comments` 4, `program_info` 10, `program_units` 7, `rigid_tapping` 5, `setup_mounts_post` 8, `smoothing` 7, `tap_hand` 7, `wear_comp` 5, `explain_option` 4, `post_script_options` 7, `per_op_script_options` 2, `post_serves_kind` 6, `lathe_workholding_mill_post` 4, `cli` 18.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- The quick plan (`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`) has 855 steps, because a post script reaches all app suites. I did not run all 855 steps. I ran each suite that reads Haas output (each test file in `crates/app/tests` and `crates/post/tests` that names Haas) and the catalog suites. The author's record on this head is 855 steps, 0 failed.
- Light lane: not re-run by me. Its 6 steps are motion and pocket toolpath twins, and this diff does not change toolpaths. The author's record on this head is 6 steps, 0 failed.

### Extra suites run

- Test data: the diff changes no file under `testdata/`. The golden directories that it changes are read by `conformance`, `program_entry`, `inverted_axis_display` and the post `recorded_streams` / `explain` / `bore_cycle` / `fine_bore_cycle` / `ream_cycle` suites. All are green above.
- Importers: the diff does not touch import code. Not applicable.

## Mutations (each in the trial merge, then restored)

| Mutation in `haas.cps` | Result |
|---|---|
| Remove `block(["G90"])` after the G28 retract | RED: `haas_program_end_restores_absolute_mode_before_m30` and 3 setup-change tests |
| `spinRev ? "M4" : "M3"` becomes `"M3"` | RED: `haas_reverse_mill_spindle_starts_m4_for_its_section_only` |
| Remove the `G84` refusal under `M4` | RED: `haas_refuses_a_right_hand_tap_under_a_reverse_spindle` |
| `M88` stops with `M9`, not `M89` | RED: `haas_stops_each_coolant_option_with_its_own_off_code` |
| Remove `G49` from the G53 retract block | RED: `haas_g53_retract_cancels_the_length_offset_and_brings_y_home` |
| Remove the `spinRev = false` reset at `OperationName` | RED: `haas_reverse_mill_spindle_starts_m4_for_its_section_only` |

Each pinning test is red on its mutation and green on the PR.

## Law check

- Prime Directive: no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` outside tests. The new refusal uses the counted `msg()`, so the in-app post blocks.
- Clean-room: the sources are the public Haas manual (behaviour only). The decision record says that no vendor post text was read.
- Process: the body has `Process change: no` and a `Changelog:` line, and ends with `Refs #1977`. `Refs` is correct, because G74 and the M88 order stay open on #1977. The commit subjects are conventional. No `CHANGELOG.md`, snapshot PNG or `PROCESS_VERSION` edit.
- No UI change, no new crate dependency, no new top-level test binary.

## Questions and notes (not blocking)

1. In G53 mode, the home ask brings Y to machine `Y0.` and does not move X. This agrees with the cited completion blocks. The G28 mode homes X and Y. An operator who changes between the two modes will see a different end position. The decision record could say this in one line.
2. The `M88` before `S.. M3` order stays open on #1977, as the body says. It is slower, not unsafe.

left for the maintainer: check 6 skip - this PR changes posted G-code (assets/posts/haas.cps). Counted clean SAFETY-tier review at 326770b51 (MacBook-Pro pool, opus 5.5, mkinney; head merged with main clean, goldens moved 33 files, mutations red then green). Merge by hand.
